name: 52-same-edit-everywhere
prompt: Every file in pkg/ has a fmt.Println debug line inside its Handler function. Remove all of those Println lines, and remove the now-unused fmt import from each file. The package must still build with go build ./... when you are done.
check: ! grep -rq 'fmt.Println' pkg/ && ! grep -rq '"fmt"' pkg/ && go build ./... && test $(ls pkg/*.go | wc -l) -eq 10
